prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 10 "Skilled worker hours": indemnified in 2 of 6 earlier cases, t = 0 in 4; when indemnified t per hr about 38 (80% range 32 to 45); revealed per hr: 35-42 (case 24), 35-40 (case 26), so this line (4 hr) about 152 (129 to 181)
- line 17 "Administrative and claim-processing fee": NOT indemnified (t = 0) in all 5 earlier cases; no price evidence

items.description: Cleaning of affected floor areas in the utility room
items.rationale: Covered as necessary cleaning of surfaces affected by the insured water escape event (7.1.7(h), 2.4.2, 7.1.5). Utility room is documented as affected.

items.description: Cleaning of affected floor areas in the adjoining hallway
items.rationale: Covered as necessary cleaning of surfaces affected by the insured water escape event (7.1.7(h), 2.4.2, 7.1.5). Hallway is documented as affected.

items.description: Inspection of the washing machine and supply/drain connection to confirm no further leakage
items.rationale: Covered as necessary investigation to confirm the source and cessation of the leak (7.1.7(e), 2.4.2).

items.description: Removal and disposal of water-damaged skirting boards
items.rationale: Covered as removal/disposal of damaged building components directly affected by the water (7.1.7(a), 2.4.2, 7.1.5).
Covered as repair/replacement of damaged building components (7.1.1(b), 2.4.2, 7.1.5). Only the affected sections are covered.

items.description: Cleaning and repainting of the upstairs bedroom not reached by the water
items.rationale: Not indemnified: work in a room not affected by the insured event is excluded (7.1.5). No evidence of water damage there.

items.description: Moisture measurement of the utility room and hallway floor
items.rationale: Covered as necessary measurement to establish extent of damage in affected areas (7.1.7(b), 2.4.2, 7.1.5).

items.description: Drying of the affected floor area
items.rationale: Covered as necessary drying of affected areas (7.1.7(b), 2.4.2, 7.1.5).
Covered as necessary equipment hire for drying affected areas (7.1.7(b), 2.4.2).
Indemnified in 2 of 6 reference cases, with t per hr about 38; covered here as necessary labour for drying/measurement in affected areas (7.1.7(g), 2.4.2).

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying of the basement storage room
items.rationale: Not indemnified: basement storage room not documented as affected by the water escape (7.1.5).

items.description: Transport of the high-value painting to the specialist restorer
items.rationale: Covered as necessary cost for securing and conserving an item of particular value affected by the insured event (5.2.6, 2.4.2).

items.description: Professional assessment of the high-value painting
items.rationale: Covered as necessary specialist assessment for conservation/restoration of an item of particular value (5.2.6, 2.4.2).

items.description: Conservatory drying and stabilisation of the painting
items.rationale: Covered as necessary drying/stabilisation of an item of particular value affected by the insured event (5.2.6, 2.4.2).
Covered as restoration of an item of particular value affected by the insured event, but capped at EUR 1,000 plus VAT as not individually scheduled (5.2.6).

items.description: Restoration of a second painting stored in the basement, unaffected by the utility-room leak
items.rationale: Not indemnified: item not affected by the insured event (7.1.5, 5.2.6).
Not indemnified: administrative/processing fees are not repair costs and are excluded in all reference cases (7.1.8(b)).
